run_I2VGenXLPipeline: run the I2VGenXLPipeline to generate a video from an input image and text prompt
encode_prompt_I2VGenXLPipeline: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings using the I2VGenXLPipeline encode_prompt method
encode_image_I2VGenXLPipeline: encode an input image into CLIP image embeddings using the I2VGenXLPipeline _encode_image method
decode_latents_I2VGenXLPipeline: decode video latents back to pixel space frames using the I2VGenXLPipeline decode_latents method
prepare_image_latents_I2VGenXLPipeline: prepare image latents with frame position masks using the I2VGenXLPipeline prepare_image_latents method
